about: Hale Barn, Pennock's barn, a room file v2 (the format: the builder's README, room files). Metres in the room's frame: x east, y north, z up, the floor's centre on the origin; 18 x 10 m inside (x -9..9, y -5..5), 4.5 m high. Every prop, spot, portal and night light of packages/content/data/scenes/barn.json is named below. Two straw stalls either side of a planked aisle behind board partitions (boxes in the joinery's wood), posts and tie beams, a hay loft over the north-east corner with a ladder up to it at the scene's loft drop (decision D6: the drop's portal at the ladder's foot). No window: the scene has none and no moon light, so the barn is lit by its three storm lanterns on the north boards. Grey boxes stand in for the pieces with no model (decision D2).
